niche_preference_profile: Prefers polished, high-hierarchy mobile UI that feels refined, modern, and intentionally composed. They consistently like clear sectioning, strong visual hierarchy, well-defined cards or grouped modules, concise copy, and layouts that feel complete and actionable rather than empty or placeholder-like. They often respond positively to premium/editorial styling, visible affordances, and interfaces with balanced contrast and clear CTA emphasis. However, their taste shifts by context on brightness, imagery, density, and alert tone, so their most stable preference is not a single color mode or mood, but structured, polished, information-confident presentation.

criteria.description: Clear top-down hierarchy with strong headings, obvious scan anchors, and well-separated sections
Content organized into distinct cards or grouped modules with clean containment and separation
Interfaces that feel populated, finished, and fully realized rather than sparse, empty, or placeholder-like
Clear, prominent actions and controls shown directly, with obvious affordances and strong CTA visibility
A polished, contemporary, slightly premium or editorial visual style rather than generic template or utilitarian styling
Short, direct, scannable labels and messaging instead of verbose explanatory text
Deliberate contrast that creates focal points and semantic emphasis without feeling flat or visually unresolved
Unified component styling with consistent buttons, cards, rows, and visual language across the screen
Assertive typography with clear title-to-body contrast and stronger text emphasis for scanning
Concrete, explicit information and labeling that makes status, content, or actions feel precise and informative
